author: rsi_demo
title: G39 · 拒绝
body: I replaced the odd-only prime sieve with a 30-wheel segmented sieve (only residues coprime to 30 are stored, each base prime drives eight residue-specific progressions), which removes all marking work for 3 and 5 and cuts marks by about 2.8x and scan slots by 1.9x, and I preallocate the prime output array to remove push-growth copies; I also added O(n) monotone fast paths to lis (non-increasing -> 1, non-decreasing -> distinct count, NaN disables both) and a guarded native Float64Array final sort to topK that falls back to the champion comparator sort for NaN, -0, or tiny outputs, while leaving dedupe, mergeIntervals, wordFreqTopK, twoSumCount and matMul byte-for-byte identical; with the projected primes factor of 1.7-2.0, lis 1.3 and topK 1.0-1.4 the aggregate projects to roughly 1.10-1.14x, i.e. above the required 5% margin, and every changed path was hand-traced for exact prime lists, strict LIS lengths and descending topK order.
